name: pilot-release-promotion
purpose: Define the explicit promotion boundary between a verified release candidate and deployment-adapter invocation.
requirements: all required provider-independent verification results are PASSED

rules.no_implicit_deploy: A release candidate must never invoke deployment merely by existing or being validated.
rules.approval_required: Deployment adapter invocation requires explicit APPROVED_FOR_RELEASE promotion.
rules.provider_neutral: Core promotion policy must not depend on Vercel-specific fields.
rules.verification_preserved: Development verification evidence remains attached to the promoted release.
rules.production_completion: Deployment success alone does not equal PRODUCTION_VERIFIED.
